about: C1b Search (WN §4.9, PLAN §1.6, §1.7 row 'Sheets, the search sheet'; default profile). The whole search sheet is one +10 mm non-interactive crop over a thick slab. With the runtime (wp.c1b) the sheet's glass is C1b's own slab .lgs-search-glass under Steam's tabbed page (same rect; Steam's page sits in a 3D context where backdrop-filter samples nothing), for the zero state too (the zero state's content is .lgs-search-zero above it); rule 'search-sheet' pops that slab, so 05-native.css zeroes its --lgs-mat-thick-* paint under the pop, and the crop carries the content above it. 'search-sheet-t1' is the fallback when the runtime failed and Steam's page alone is the sheet (it overlaps a kept 'search-sheet' and is dropped otherwise). Popped rects never overlap (lgs_layers.js), so nothing inside the sheet pops on its own: the focused result rides on the sheet with its CSS lift x1.05. The snapshot (.lgs-snap), the scrim, the scope bar, the discs and the Software cell never pop. Click-safe: the smallest focusable inside the sheet is a 60 px segment (s >= 52 admits +10). Behind wp.c1b (PLAN §1.17); the legacy 'tabs', 'tab-arrow' and 'card' pops on /search overlap the kept sheet and are dropped by the reporter, so no supersede is needed (those ids also serve library routes).
